[00:00] Welcome to the Seegson Operational Safety Briefing for Mining-Class Vessels.
[00:14] Always wear your environment suit when entering Cargo Bays C1 through C4.
[00:31] In the event of a hull integrity warning, proceed immediately to your assigned muster point.
[01:05] Xenobiological contact protocols: Section 7, Appendix D of your crew handbook.
[01:20] Note that all biological samples require quarantine in Bay C2 isolation cells.
[07:44] Seegson values your safety. Your survival is our bottom line.
[08:34] END OF MANDATORY VIEWING
